_doc: One row per agent browser on the shared Mac. port = its CDP port (unique, 9222–9299) · profile = its own Chrome user-data-dir (no spaces) · color = #RRGGBB (the theme's frame) · label = the name written on the frame. Optional: state, log, launcher (+ launcherEnv), managedBy (another program owns it — report only), idleMinutes (its reaper may idle-stop it), noTheme, ports ("41000-41099": its own port range for port-owner; default 100 ports from 41000 + 100 × (CDP port − 9222)). Top level: humanPorts — ports no agent may lease (default: 3000, 5173, 8000, 8080 and the other usual ones). chrome: stable | beta | dev | canary | cft | a path to a Chrome .app. Per agent apps ({"Notes": "deny", "Terminal": "allow"}): apps it may or may not drive. Top level: deniedApps (default: terminals, System Settings, Keychain Access, Passwords, Activity Monitor), sensitiveSites (domains an agent opens only while the human is at the Mac).
